name: Living Room
description: The central gathering space for relaxing, entertaining, and everyday life.

name: Bedroom
description: A restful private retreat built around comfort, storage, and calm lighting.

name: Kitchen
description: The functional heart of the home, balancing workflow, storage, and style.

name: Bathroom
description: A moisture-conscious space where fixtures, surfaces, and lighting must work together.

name: Dining Room
description: A space designed around shared meals, seating comfort, and ambient lighting.

name: Home Office
description: A focused workspace that supports productivity, storage, and video calls.

name: Entryway
description: The first impression of the home, balancing storage with a welcoming feel.

name: Balcony
description: A compact outdoor extension of the home for plants, seating, and fresh air.

name: Outdoor Area
description: Patios, yards, and courtyards designed for gathering and weather-resistant comfort.

name: Nursery
description: A soothing, safety-conscious room designed around a growing child's needs.

name: Guest Room
description: A flexible, welcoming space for visitors that can double as a multi-use room.

name: Basement
description: An underused lower level with potential for storage, media, or living space.

name: Other
description: Any other space in the home that doesn't fit a standard room category.
